name: peskio
description: Tides and fishing conditions for Europe, North Africa and US coasts.

interface.longDescription: Plan coastal outings with tide predictions, wind and sea forecasts, water-clarity estimates and estimated fish activity for 43,000+ places across Europe, North Africa and US coasts. Explore nearby spots and compare days for fishing, snorkeling or diving, with links to more detail on Peskio. Clarity and temperature estimates describe surface conditions; conditions at depth are unavailable. These forecasts support planning and do not assess whether an outing is safe.

positive.description: Compare local fishing days and windows at a named coastal place; weekend dates depend on current local date.
positive.prompt: Best time to fish at Cadaqués this weekend?
positive.expected_behavior: Resolve Cadaqués to its returned placeId; compare the requested weekend dates, explain the better day and local best window using returned bite/conditions values, and include the exact returned canonical URL with all UTM parameters.

positive.description: Spanish tide query with a relative date and local times.
positive.prompt: ¿A qué hora es la marea alta en Sitges mañana?
positive.expected_behavior: Resolve Sitges and request tomorrow in the place timezone. Give the returned high-tide times, identify predicted heights and datum if provided, and include the exact Spanish Peskio link with UTM parameters.

positive.description: Find nearby shore-fishing spots around a named centre.
positive.prompt: Where near Barcelona is best for shore fishing tomorrow?
positive.expected_behavior: Use the returned Barcelona placeId, tomorrow and shore discipline. Rank returned nearby coastal spots, separate bite score from shore verdict, and link every recommended place using its exact returned URL. Do not substitute a name-only general map.

positive.description: Coast exposure information from the place profile.
positive.prompt: Is Port de la Selva sheltered from a tramontana (north wind)?
positive.expected_behavior: Resolve Port de la Selva and answer from returned shelteredFrom/exposedTo fields. State unknowns if absent; include its exact returned profile URL. Exposure information is not navigation clearance.

positive.description: French predicted tide coefficient, explicitly distinguished from official values.
positive.prompt: Coefficient de marée à Saint-Malo aujourd'hui ?
positive.expected_behavior: Resolve Saint-Malo and today locally. Answer in French, explicitly label coefficient as estimation Peskio/non officielle, include local tide times if returned and the exact French canonical link with UTM parameters.

negative.description: Inland weather is outside Peskio: no Peskio tools; explain scope or use a separate source.
Recipes are outside Peskio: no Peskio tools; general cooking answer is allowed.
Booking is unsupported: no Peskio tools, no booking or invented confirmation.
negative.prompt: Book a ferry from Tarifa to Tangier

publication.release_notes: Initial public release: coastal tide predictions, fishing-day comparisons, nearby spots and coast profiles, with exact Peskio links and explicit model-estimate limits.
